content: Judíoʼmar, e-isdarmaladgi nakwisad

Rey-e-igar-mesisadi, e-igar-uksadi, nii-warambe-gakabogi, e-ibambe-gakapaagi, imaklegoye soglesad. We-nii-warambe-gakabogwad, Adar-niiye nugad. A-ibagine, Judíoʼmar-e-isdarmalad, Judío-dulemar-ogilomaloye binsasanad. Degi-inigwele, aka bur ibmar sorsik-gusad. Ar a-ibagine, Judío-dulemar e-isdarmaladgi naknonimalad.

Bela Rey-Asuero-yarmar-dakmaidgine, Judío-dulemar, e-isdarmalad-e-oburgwebimalad-abin-samalagala, na guagwar e-neggwebur-e-neggwebur-mamaidgine ambikusmalad. Degi-inigwele, bipisaale dulemar, Judío-dulemar-abin gwisgussurmalad, ar ade, bela Judío-dulemar-dobgudmalad.
Bela yarmargi-dummaganga-mamaid, dummagan-Sátrapaʼmar, sordamar-dummagan, degi, reyga-dummaganga-gudimaladi, Mardoqueo-dobed-ular, Judío-dulemar-bendaknai gusmalad.
Mardoqueoʼde, reyneggi dule-dummadga gunonikid. Bela yarmar-ugakaase e-nug dungumai gusad. Bane-bane bur gangumai gusad.
Judío-dulemar es-suidgi e-isdarmalad-oburgwismalad, bela giir-imaksamalad. Judío-dulemar, e-isdarmalad-igi-imakbie, deyobi na imaksamalad.
Judío-dulemar, Susa-neggweburgine dulataled-ilatar (500) dule-oburgwismalad.
Wemar, Hamedata-machi-Amán-e-masmala-warambegwadid (10). Amánʼde, Judío-dulemar-e-isdaradid. Degi-inigwele, Judío-dulemar amar-ibe e-ibmarmardi sussurmalad.
A-ibagine, Rey-Asuero Susa-neggweburgi igi-mergu dulemar-burgwisye wisguargua,

e-ome-Esterʼga sogded: —Ar Judíoʼmar Susa-neggweburgi dulataled-ilatar (500) dule-oburgwismalale, degi, Amán-masmala-warambegwad (10) oburgwismarbalile, ¿An-yarmar-baigangi, igi neg-imaksamarbar be insae? Ester, be anga sogbali, ¿Ar ibu be egisbibali? Ar bega uklegoed. ¿Ibu be abebali? Ar be-sogedba bega ibmar imaklegoed.

Ester, Reyga sogded: —Rey, be yeer-itogele, Judíoʼmar igi emi neg-imaksamala, deyobi, banedse be igar-megisadba, Judíoʼmar-Susa-neggweburginmalad na e-isdarmalad-obelogega be igar uke. Amán-e-masmala-e-ambegid-e-muimardi (10) bannu-bannu nasikega be imake.
Rey-Asuero, Ester-ibmar-sogsadba, ibmar-imakega igar uksad. Susa-neggweburgi igar-uklenai gusad. Geb Amán-e-masmala-e-ambegid-e-mui (10) bannu-bannu nasiksamalad.

Judío-dulemar-Susa-neggweburginmaladi nii-Adarʼye-nugadgi, e-ibambe-gakabakegi na bulakwaa ambikusmarmogad. Geb agi, dulataled-ilapaa (300) dulemar-oburgwismalad. Degi-inigwele, e-ibmarmardi gwen e-ibe sussurmalad.
Purim-e-iba

Judíoʼmar-baigan Rey-yar-bamaladgi-gudidimaladdi, na e-isdarmaladgi san-bendakmalaga, degi, e-isdarmaladgi ollorgumalaga na danakwaa ambikusmarmogad. Amala, mili-dulapaa-gakambe-gakatar (75,000) e-isdarmalad-oburgwismalad. Degi-inigwele, e-ibmarmardi e-ibe sussurmalad.
Weyob neggusadi, Adar-nii-ibambe-gakapaagi (13) gusad. A-banedgine, Judío-dulemar obunnosmalad. A-ibagi, weligwaledgi iba-dummad onosmalad.

Ar Judío-dulemar-Susa-neggweburginmalad, ibambe-gakapaagi, degi, ibambe-gakabakegi na bulakwaa ambikusmalad. Amardi, ibambe-gakatargi obunnosmalad. Geb a-ibagine, weligwaledgi iba-dummad onosmarmogad.
A-ulale, Judío-dulemar-neggwebur-burwigangi-bukmalad Adar-nii-ibambe-gakabakegi (14) weligwaledgi iba-dummad onodamalad. A-ibagi, na muchub-muchub binsa ibmar ukdamalad.
Mardoqueo we-ibmarmar-gusad narmakar mesisad. Mardoqueo bela Judío-dulemar Rey-Asuero-yarmar-dikasulidgi-bukwadse, degi, itakaa-bukwadse gardamar barmisad.
A-gardagine, Mardoqueo Judío-dulemarga igar-uknaid, birga-iliba, nii-Adarʼye-nugad-ibambe-gakabakegi, degi, e-ibambe-gakatargi iba-onodii gumaloye.

Adi, ebinsamalaga, a-ibagi Judío-dulemar e-isdarmaladgi ollorgusye. Deginbali, ebinsamarbaliga, igi a-niigi Judío-dulemar-e-bukib-binsaed, e-wile-itoged, ega weligwaledga, degi, iba-dummadga gunoni gusye. A-ulale, a-iba weligwaledgi, mas-bukidar-gullenai onomaloed. Aginbali, na muchub-muchub ibmar-uknanai imakmarbaloed, deginbali, dule-wileganga ibmar-uknai gumarbaloed.
Ar igi Mardoqueo gardagi-narmakar ega igar-uksagusa, deyobi, Judío-dulemar we-iba-onoleged onodii gumaloye sogsamalad.
Ar ade, Agag-dule-Hamedata-machi-Amán, bela Judío-dulemar-ogilogega na igar-amisgusad. Amánʼde, Judío-dulemar-e-isdaradid. Geb Amán, Purʼgi wilub-daksad, adi, wisguega ede sana Judíoʼmar-obelogoe.

Ar Ester, Rey-Asuero-asabin-gwisgudapgua, rey gardagi-narmakar igar uksad. Amán Judío-dulemargi igar-isgana-amisgusadi, aka Amánʼgi aibinega imakye. Degi, Amán e-machimarmala dukargi-edinnar suargi nasikmarye.
A-ulale, wilub-daked-Purʼye-nugadba we-ibamar Purimʼye onugsasmalad. Deyobi, Judío-dulemar garda-narmaklesadba, degi, ibmar-daksamaladba, degine, ibmar-gusad-itosadba, igar mesismalad.

Judío-dulemar, na emarga, e-waganga, degi, bela eba-nanaimaladga, we-iba onoleged-igar mesismalad. We-iba degisadegu birga-irba ibabo-onoledii guoye igar mesismalad. Ar igi gardagi we-iba onolegoye sognai, deyobi onolegoed. Deginbali, ibi-ibagi onolegoye sognai, a-ibagi onolegoed.

Bela Judíoʼmar, degi, e-wagan-danimaloed, bela yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, bela neggwebur-baid-baidgi-bukmalad, we-iba ebinsadii, degi, onodii gumaloed. Judíoʼmar we-iba gege onosuli gumaloed, adi, e-wagan melle we-iba iemalagar.
Abihail-sisgwa-Rey-ome-Ester, Judío-dule-Mardoqueoʼbo, bela gangued-nikadba we-garda-sogbogwadgi Purim-Iba-onogedgi narmaksamalad.
We-gardamar nuedgi, degi, napiragwadgi narmakale, bela Judío-dulemar Rey-Asuero-yarmar-dulanergwa-gakaguglegi-bukwadse (127) barmismalad.

We-gardagine, Mardoqueo, Esterʼbo Judío-dulemarga, degi, e-waganga igar uknaid. Purim-Iba-onoleged na gusgu-e-iba-maidba onomaloye. Deginbali, a-gardagine sognaibalid, igi mas-gunsuli-gudigued-e-iba onomarbaloe, degi, igi wile-itoged na oyomarbaloe.
Ester-igar-uksadi, Purim-Iba-onolegoed-e-igar-maid bargindisad. Bela we-ibmarmar gardagi narmakar megisad.
